description: Search the Bookatu help centre, the plain-language guides to every feature, in any of its 14 languages. Returns the guides that match, closest first, with their summary, page, markdown copy and the dashboard screen each is set up on.

language.description: Optional. The language to search and answer in: en, de, fr, es, it, nl, pt, da, sv, nb, fi, pl, ja, cs (a tag like de-DE works too). Defaults to English; a language Bookatu has no catalog for reads English. The question itself may be written in any of these languages.

limit.description: Optional. How many guides, 1 to 10. Default 5.

query.description: What you want to know, in your own words, e.g. "how do I take a deposit".

name: search_help
